Guide.Reference / interpretation: 2026-10-11; target Motorola Razr 2022 (oneli), ARM64 native mainline NUC; no phone boot, flash or physical measurement was performed.
Direct value in oneli-specific overlay / Motorola display-oneli file.

Present as an alternative in source; must not be counted as working/fitted hardware.
Reasonable SoC-level inference, NOT verified part or active configuration.
An exact compatible or chip ID was found in inspected upstream source snapshot. Still NOT a Razr boot test.
